title: rDPS Meter
changeNote: 0.1.34 - Burn from ARAM: Mayhem is now credited. Its ticks on enemies were dropped from the meter entirely; they now count as damage for whoever applied the Burn, split by the stacks each player put on. The fix is generic, so other mods' damage-over-time powers that tick the same way are covered too. Builds and binds against every version from v0.107.1 to v0.111.0.
